description:
Section 73 application for minor amendment to vary condition 3 of planning permission PP/2015/4682 dated 18/02/2016 to amend the approved drawings which relate to the Western Access pertaining to the 2016 masterplan in respect of outline approval for demolition of 22 houses; the remediation of the land and the redevelopment of the site to deliver a large mixed use development including residential, non-food retail, food retail, restaurants, bars and cafes, hotel, conference and banqueting, cinema, health care facilities, education facilities, office/studio units, car park, sports pavilion, an energy centre, multi-storey car park and associated car and cycle parking, landscaping, public realm, open space and children's play space.

The proposed amendments are for the inclusion of a dedicated cycle lane at the Western Access, minor amendments to the Pump Lane junction and a revised landscape and drainage strategy for the area
